topic: Fixing an Overpaid Credit Card Bill

script.title: PAID A LITTLE TOO MUCH
script.scene_zh: 客服熱線 · 處理多繳
script.story_hook: One more click than she meant to pay.
script.intro_zh: 她不小心多按了一次付款鍵。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're fixing an overpaid card bill.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎大家回來！今天我們要處理一筆多付的信用卡帳單。
script.outro: You made it through all eighteen lines. Keep listening, and I'll see you next episode.
script.outro_zh: 你聽完了全部十八句。繼續多聽，我們下一集再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat every line together, one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一句一句，一起重複每句話。

Overpaid your credit card bill by mistake? This very realistic customer-service call shows exactly what to say. Join Dana as she checks a negative balance, asks for a refund check, updates her address, and confirms nothing is owed this cycle — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section at the end.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💳多付卡費英文｜查詢負額・申請退款・核對地址｜聽完就會打客服｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
信用卡不小心多繳了錢，該怎麼辦？
負數餘額會自己消失嗎？退款支票真的會寄來嗎？

這一集帶大家走進一通打給信用卡客服的電話，跟著 Dana 從確認負額、申請退款支票、更新住址，一路到核對這期帳單，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
💳 說明狀況：例如「I think I clicked pay one too many times.」。
📮 申請退款：例如「Sure, but a refund check is faster, actually.」。
🏠 核對帳單：例如「Then I don't owe anything this cycle?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次遇到多付錢，你也能從容打一通電話，把它妥善處理好！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a payment receipt while on the phone

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I paid too much on my credit card bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ peɪd təˈmɑtʃ ɑn maɪ ˈkrɛdɪt kɑrd bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我的信用卡帳單付太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? Do you see a negative balance now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ du ju si ə ˈnɛɡətɪv ˈbæləns naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 喔？那妳現在看到的是負數餘額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it shows minus sixty dollars, um…
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ʃoʊz ˈmaɪnəs ˈsɪksti ˈdɑlərz ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 對，上面顯示負六十美元，呃……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that means you paid twice by mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ðæt minz ju peɪd twaɪs baɪ mɪˈsteɪk/
dialogue.zh: 明白了，那代表妳不小心繳了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I clicked pay one too many times.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ klɪkt peɪ wʌn tu ˈmɛni taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 我想我按付款鍵按太多次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens, no worries at all here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz noʊ ˈwɜriz ət ɔl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事，完全不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So can you move the money to next month?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ju muv ðə ˈmʌni tu nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 那你們可以把錢轉到下個月嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but a refund check is faster, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr bət ə ˈrifʌnd tʃɛk ɪz ˈfæstər ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，其實寄退款支票會更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A check? How long does that usually take?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tʃɛk haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðæt ˈjuʒəwəli teɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About seven to ten days by mail, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈsɛvən tə tɛn deɪz baɪ meɪl aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想寄信大約七到十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, my address changed last week, so…
dialogue.phonetic: /həm maɪ əˈdrɛs tʃeɪnd læst wik soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我上個星期才搬家，所以……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we'll update it before mailing it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm wil ˈəpdeɪt ɪt bɪˈfɔr ˈmelɪŋ ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，寄出之前我們會先更新地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! Then I don't owe anything this cycle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðɛn aɪ doʊt oʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ ðɪs ˈsaɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那這期我完全不用繳錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's right, nothing owed, you're all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts raɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ oʊd jʊr ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，一分都不欠，都搞定啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, thanks for explaining it so patiently.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju θæŋks fɔr ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ ɪt soʊ ˈpeɪʃəntli/
dialogue.zh: 呼，謝謝你這麼有耐心地跟我解釋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My job! Do you need help with anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dʒɑb du ju nid hɛlp wɪð ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 這是我該做的！還需要別的地方幫忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that's everything, have a good afternoon!
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæts ˈɛvriθɪŋ hæv ə ɡʊd ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 不了，全都問完了，祝你下午愉快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Thanks for calling today, bye now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu θæŋks fɔr ˈkɔlɪŋ təˈdeɪ baɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你也是！謝謝今天來電，再見。
